name: OmAiry
author: Tiedeyez
description: A small winged Omarchy mark that lives on your desktop. The Omarchy icon is its body, with block wings and a block-art glow in your theme's accent colour. It flies in lazy arcs, visits the window you are working in and perches on it to rest. Click it and it teaches you an Omarchy keybinding or command in a card styled like Omarchy's popups. Starts no processes, touches no files, makes no network requests; hides under fullscreen windows and holds still when animations are off.
